derivations.notes: Forecast arithmetic does not independently validate planning assumptions or measured bases.

source_references: the exact source identity, digest, or URL recorded in the inventoried artifact

metadata.formula: Deterministically enumerate admitted logical executions, shards, partitions, and aggregate counts from the bound campaign inputs.

derivations.notes: A compiled plan proves construction and arithmetic closure, not target behavior or scientific completeness.
derivations.title: Deterministic campaign-plan aggregation

metadata.construction_rule: The schema and generator fix non-authority, planning-only, or non-execution flags as protective classification invariants.

derivations.notes: A protective false flag prevents overclaiming but is not affirmative evidence that an independent audit occurred.
derivations.title: Protective non-authority and non-execution declaration

metadata.construction_rule: The constructor emits the literal or uniform sentence without evaluating independent source evidence for that row.

derivations.notes: These fields preserve historical context but cannot close discovery, reconciliation, audit, or semantic-completeness gates.
derivations.title: Legacy literal audit and reconciliation output

metadata.inference_rule: Flag a category below five features; absence of a flag is only a threshold result and does not establish semantic completeness.
supporting_evidence_references: calculated feature count per declared category

derivations.notes: The former no-suspicious-sparsity prose is visibly weaker than measurement or research evidence.
derivations.title: Category sparsity threshold inference

metadata.decision_scope: Repository-governed labels, selections, dispositions, and safety policies are decisions unless separately bound to research or external evidence.

derivations.notes: Governance state is not an observed runtime fact.
derivations.title: Governed registry selection or disposition

metadata.formula: Emit one requirement per executable template and calculate reuse only from exact semantic projection and obligation references.
input_references: executable obligation templates and inspected vector-definition files

derivations.notes: Missing/reusable status is calculated coverage bookkeeping, not empirical evidence.
derivations.title: Generated vector-requirement and reuse accounting

metadata.methodology: Apply the snapshot's candidate, identity, source-priority, and disposition rules to its bound source identities.

derivations.notes: The sources and reviewed methodology, not generator repetition, are the evidence basis.
derivations.title: Researched semantic disposition and source synthesis

metadata.construction_rule: Expand every feature across the declared facet/case template and verify that the generated expansion contains the same declared facets.

derivations.notes: Presence of every generated facet proves structural template closure only; it cannot prove researched semantic completeness.
derivations.title: Declared facet-template construction

measured_inputs: source-bound immutable evidence, artifact bytes, or execution records

derivations.notes: A measurement supports only the observed or measured state, not a normative expectation.

authority_references: verifier and report-builder implementations named by each artifact
input_references: the exact cases, attempts, observations, shards, manifests, or rows named by the report

metadata.formula: Recompute counts, commitments, and reconciliation status from the named input population.

derivations.notes: Reconciliation proves agreement with inputs; it does not upgrade those inputs to independent evidence.
derivations.title: Deterministic reconciliation and summary aggregation
